Compliance sign-off is strictly enforced and must be routed through the Legal desk, specifically overseen by Ashley Morris (CLO) to ensure GDPR alignment.

PUBLIC RELATIONS, SOCIAL MEDIA & MEDIA INQUIRIES: 
Spokespersons: Only designated members of the Marketing and Executive teams are authorized to speak to the press on behalf of Chromatic Prism Corp. 
Inquiries: All unprompted media requests must be forwarded immediately to the CMO, Andrea Ross. 
Social Media: Employees are encouraged to share published company news. However, staff are strictly prohibited from leaking or discussing unannounced internal initiatives, roadmaps, or beta programs (specifically including confidential efforts like Project Nova Warden) on personal social media platforms like X, LinkedIn, or Reddit.

CODE OF CONDUCT, ETHICS, & WHISTLEBLOWER POLICY: 
Zero Tolerance: Chromatic Prism Corp maintains a strict zero-tolerance policy regarding workplace harassment, discrimination, insider trading, and retaliation. 
Reporting Hierarchy: Violations should be immediately reported to your direct Director. 
Whistleblower Exception: If the offending party is your Director or higher, the report must bypass the standard chain of command. 
Ethics Hotline: Anonymous reports can be submitted via the 24/7 Ethics Portal, which is maintained by an external third party and audited directly by the Operations department, overseen by Matthew Miller (COO).

Standard Issue: New engineering hires are provisioned with an Apple MacBook Pro M3 Max or equivalent Linux workstation. Non-engineering staff are provisioned with standard ultrabooks. 
Custom Requests: Requests for specialized hardware, multi-GPU compute rigs, or testing devices must be logged via the IT Service Desk.

INCIDENT RESPONSE (IR) & SEVERITY CLASSIFICATION: 
Definitions: 
SEV-1 (Critical): Total system outage or active data breach. All hands required. 
SEV-2 (High): Core feature broken for >10% of customers. 
SEV-3 (Medium): Degradation of non-critical services. 
Procedures: For SEV-1 and SEV-2 incidents, a temporary 'War Room' channel is created. An Incident Commander (IC) is appointed to direct engineering traffic. 
Post-Mortem: Within 48 hours of incident resolution, a blameless root-cause analysis (RCA) document must be published to the Engineering Wiki. The CTO, Tracy Richardson, reviews all SEV-1 post-mortems.

DATA PRIVACY & PII HANDLING (GDPR/CCPA COMPLIANCE): 
Scope: This directive dictates the handling of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) of Chromatic Prism Corp's users. 
Storage Requirements: All PII must be encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit via TLS 1.3. 
Data Retention: User analytics data is retained for 24 months before anonymization. Billing records are kept for 7 years to comply with tax laws. 
Right to be Forgotten: Customer requests for data deletion must be executed within 14 business days across all primary and backup databases. 
Compliance Officer: The execution of our privacy framework falls under the mandate of the CLO, Ashley Morris.

REMOTE WORK & TELECOMMUTING POLICY (V2.4): 
Scope: Applies to all full-time and part-time staff of Chromatic Prism Corp.
Guidelines: Employees reporting directly to the CEO, Jim Walker, or any C-level executive (e.g., Tracy Richardson, the CTO) are classified as 'Hybrid-Essential' and must be present at the corporate headquarters a minimum of 4 days per week (Monday-Thursday). 
Staff operating under the Director level are granted 'Flexible Remote' status. 
Exceptions: Medical exceptions or permanent relocations must be documented and countersigned by the CHRO, Joanne Salinas. 
Stipend: Fully remote employees are eligible for a one-time ₹15000 home office provisioning stipend upon their 90-day anniversary.

OPEN SOURCE SOFTWARE (OSS) INTEGRATION & LICENSING: 
Approved Licenses: Engineering teams may freely integrate third-party libraries licensed under MIT, Apache 2.0, or BSD. 
Restricted Licenses: Code operating under GPL (General Public License), AGPL, or any viral 'copyleft' license cannot be integrated into proprietary Chromatic Prism Corp codebases under any circumstances. 
Approval Process: Exceptions to the GPL restriction require an architecture review and explicit, documented clearance from the Legal department, signed by Ashley Morris (CLO). Failure to comply may result in termination.

INFORMATION SECURITY (INFOSEC) & ACCESS CONTROL: 
Endpoint Security: All employee endpoints accessing the Chromatic Prism Corp VPN must run the mandatory CrowdStrike Falcon agent and our proprietary Mobile Device Management (MDM) profile. 
Authentication: Passwords must be a minimum of 16 characters, utilize mixed casing/symbols, and be rotated every 90 days. YubiKey hardware MFA is required for all AWS and Production Database access. 
Incident Reporting: Lost or stolen devices must be reported to the Helpdesk within 2 hours of discovery. 
Escalation: Severe data breaches or ransomware indicators trigger a SEV-1 alert, immediately escalating to Mark Doyle, the CIO, and the corporate legal team.

PAID TIME OFF (PTO), LEAVE, & SABBATICAL: 
Structure: Chromatic Prism Corp utilizes an 'Unlimited/Discretionary PTO' model for salaried exempt employees. 
Approval Matrix: Continuous leave of 1 to 4 days requires standard Manager approval. Leave spanning 5 to 14 continuous business days requires a 30-day advance notice and formal approval from your department Director. 
Sabbatical: Employees achieving 5 continuous years of service are eligible for a 6-week fully paid sabbatical. 
Parental Leave: Primary caregivers receive 16 weeks of fully paid leave; secondary caregivers receive 8 weeks. 
Administration: All medical, FMLA, and parental leave cases bypass the standard hierarchy and are strictly managed by the HR Benefits Portal under the authority of Joanne Salinas.

CORPORATE TRAVEL & EXPENSE REIMBURSEMENT (T&E): 
Air Travel: Domestic flights must be booked Economy class. International flights exceeding 8 continuous hours of airtime may be booked in Premium Economy or Business Class with VP approval. 
Per Diem: Meal expenses are capped at ₹7500/day for domestic travel and ₹18000/day for international travel. Alcohol is not reimbursable unless entertaining external clients. 
Software Subscriptions: Unauthorized 'shadow IT' SaaS subscriptions over ₹5000/month must be pre-approved by IT and Finance. 
Auditing: Expense reports must be submitted via Confluence within 30 days. Expense anomalies and continuous violations are subject to quarterly audit by Sean Pugh (CFO).

PERFORMANCE REVIEW & PROMOTION CYCLE: 
Cadence: Chromatic Prism Corp executes formal performance evaluations bi-annually (May and November). 
Structure: The review consists of a self-evaluation, peer 360-feedback, and a Manager calibration. 
Performance Improvement Plans (PIP): Employees failing to meet KPI targets for two consecutive quarters will be placed on a 60-day PIP. PIP templates must be drafted in coordination with the HR Business Partner. 
Promotions: Out-of-cycle promotions are strictly prohibited unless authorized by the department's C-level executive and the CFO, Sean Pugh, to ensure salary band compliance.

BRAND ASSET GUIDELINES: 
Logo Usage: The Chromatic Prism Corp primary logo must maintain a minimum clear space equal to 50% of the logo's height. The logo must never be stretched, recolored, or placed on a heavily patterned background. 
Typography: The official corporate typefaces are 'Inter' for digital interfaces and web copy, and 'Merriweather' for printed collateral and formal letterheads.
